description: This file defines the PDCP (Packet Data Convergence Protocol) transmission entity for a mobile communication stack, including state management, buffer handling, security, header compression, and interface methods for SDU/PDU processing and notifications.

classes.name: pdcp_entity_tx
classes.description: Final class managing the transmission side of a PDCP bearer, handling SDU/PDU processing, security, header compression, timers, and notifications.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_state
classes.description: Struct representing the transmission state variables for PDCP, including sequence numbers and reordering info.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_buffer_info
classes.description: Helper struct for passing buffer and security info to security functions.

classes.name: pdcp_tx_pdu_info
classes.description: Helper struct for passing PDUs and metadata to lower layers.

methods.name: crypto_awaitable
methods.description: Returns an awaitable event for crypto task completion.

methods.name: notify_pdu_processing_stopped
methods.description: Notifies that PDU processing has stopped.

methods.name: get_count
methods.description: Retrieves current TX count info for status transfer.

methods.name: set_count
methods.description: Sets the TX count info for status transfer.

methods.name: set_status_provider
methods.description: Sets the status provider for inter-layer communication.

methods.name: prepend_data_pdu_header
methods.description: Prepends data PDU header to buffer.

methods.name: retransmit_all_pdus
methods.description: Retransmits all PDUs with security re-application.

methods.name: check_early_drop
methods.description: Checks if a PDU should be dropped early based on buffer conditions.

methods.name: apply_reordering
methods.description: Applies ciphering and integrity protection for reordering.

methods.name: write_data_pdu_to_lower_layers
methods.description: Sends data PDU to lower layers.

methods.name: write_control_pdu_to_lower_layers
methods.description: Sends control PDU to lower layers.

methods.name: apply_ciphering_and_integrity_protection
methods.description: Performs ciphering and integrity protection on payload.

methods.name: stop_discard_timer
methods.description: Stops discard timers up to a specified count.

methods.name: get_pdu_size
methods.description: Estimates size of a PDU from SDU.

methods.name: handle_transmit_notification_impl
methods.description: Implements common logic for transmit/retransmit notifications.

methods.name: handle_delivery_notification_impl
methods.description: Implements common logic for delivery/retransmitted notifications.
